messages:
joel: quick design check on the first-run checklist drawer I uploaded to Figma — trying a left-side drawer vs bottom sheet. link in thread.

marta: left drawer looks fine on desktop but will eat horizontal space on small laptops. bottom sheet keeps vertical rhythm.

kevin: implementation note: bottom sheet interacts poorly with our existing toast system (toasts overlay). prefer drawer to avoid z-index hacks.

maria: UX trade: drawer better for multitasking, sheet feels more app-like for guided flows. proposal: bottom sheet on mobile, drawer on >=960px.

joel: agreed. i'll add breakpoint rule. also note: keyboard users should be able to open/close with Escape and the drawer must trap focus.

a11y-bot: reminder: add aria-labelledby and aria-modal, ensure focus return on close, and add live region updates when checklist items change.

marta: copy: change step labels to actionable verbs: Step 1 "Create project", Step 2 "Connect model", Step 3 "Run quickstart". CTA text for step 3: "Run quickstart" not "Start".

kevin: virtualization note: drawer content is long (templates list). will lazy-load templates and keep skeletons to reduce TTI. posting ENG-4802.

maria: analytics: track onboarding_drawer_open, onboarding_drawer_completed, onboarding_template_selected. want A/B test for drawer header copy: "Set up your first project" vs "Create your first project". keys: drawer_header_v1/v2.

joel: microinteraction: when a template is selected, show ephemeral inline toast "Sample ready  Open quickstart" with a direct action. keep toasts anchored near drawer to maintain spatial relationship.

a11y-bot: ensure toasts are announced via polite aria-live and include skip links for keyboard users.

marta: layout tweak: reduce template thumbnail height to 72px for denser scans. also add badge color tokens update for dark mode.

kevin: i'll PR layout changes and ENG-4802 for loading. pinging this thread when ready. :rocket:

joel: thanks all  i'll lock copy noon PT tomorrow to hand off to i18n. please drop last tweaks in-thread.
